description_en: Searches for fare quotes for a single flight
kebab_example: aliyun btripopen flight-ota-search-v2 --search-journeys '[{"arr_city_code":"HGH","dep_city_code":"BJS","dep_date":"2023-09-01","selected_flights":[{"arr_city_code":"HGH","operate_flight_no":"CX601","dep_airport_code":"PKX","flight_time":"2023-09-01_07:10:00","arr_airport_code":"HGH","dep_city_code":"BJS","market_flight_no":"HO3925"}]}]' --trip-type 1 --search-mode 2 --cabin-type-list 0 --need-share-flight true --direct-only true --isv-name ceshi --x-acs-btrip-corp-token Dj2laAwE00 --api-version 2022-05-20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: FlightOtaSearchV2

element_fields.help_en: The three-letter code of the arrival city
element_fields.name: arr_city_code

element_fields.help_en: The departure date in yyyy-MM-dd format
element_fields.name: dep_date

element_fields.help_en: The operating flight number (e.g., CX601, available for codeshare flights)
element_fields.help_zh: 承运方航班号（如：CX601 共享航班时有值）
element_fields.name: operate_flight_no

element_fields.help_en: The departure time in yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss format
element_fields.help_zh: 起飞时间 格式yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss
element_fields.name: flight_time

element_fields.help_en: The three-letter code of the departure city
element_fields.name: dep_city_code

element_fields.help_en: The three-letter code of the arrival city
element_fields.name: arr_city_code

element_fields.help_en: The three-letter code of the departure airport
element_fields.name: dep_airport_code

element_fields.help_en: The three-letter code of the arrival airport
element_fields.name: arr_airport_code

element_fields.help_en:
The list of selected flights for the current origin-destination (OD) pair.
The list of selected flights for the current OD pair.
selected_flights must be selected from the results returned by the "Flight List Search V2" operation
element_fields.help_zh:
当前OD已选航班列表
当前OD已选航班列表
selected_flights需要从“航班列表搜索V2”的返回结果中选取航班
element_fields.name: selected_flights

parameters.help_en:
The cabin type for search. Default value: ALL_CABIN (all cabins).
<notice>Although the parameter structure is a list, only a single cabin type is supported. Multiple cabin types are not supported.</notice>
parameters.help_zh:
搜索舱等类型, 默认-ALL_CABIN 所有舱位
<notice>虽然参数结构为List，但目前只支持单个舱等，不支持多个舱等</notice>
parameters.name: cabin_type_list

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether codeshare flights are needed. Default value: TRUE
parameters.help_zh: 是否需要共享航班, 默认-TRUE
parameters.name: need_share_flight

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to show only direct flights. Default value: TRUE
parameters.help_zh: 只展示直达航班, 默认-TRUE
parameters.name: direct_only

parameters.help_en: A header parameter. Obtained from the "Enterprise Access Credential" operation (added in the header)
parameters.help_zh: header参数,由“企业访问凭证”接口获取（添加在header里）
parameters.name: x_acs_btrip_corp_token
